messages:
mira: Quick async pulse — stitching kernel hotpath + KV cache work. Need cross-team callouts: kernel PRs, kv prefetch gating, and infra canary window. Who owns final rollback policy?

sebastian: I own kernel rollout. current blocker is the kernel perf test failing on long sequences.

anika: KV prefetch has a dependency on the config flag flip. I can toggle but need verification that kernel change keeps header size stable.

lia: FYI infra limits nodes for canary at 20% right now. Can only do 10% this week due to capacity; can increase next Tue.

ryan: Happy to review kernel PR once CI green. Pinged in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/472

dev-bot: CI passed for runtime/pull/472 — artifacts: gs://redwood-builds/runtime/472

sebastian: Thanks @ryan. Timeline: merge plan is canary Mon 09:00 UTC, 10% for 4h, then 50% if no regressions. Rollback policy: infra will auto-revert on latency > +15% or error rate > 0.5%.

anika: For the flag toggle, here's the snippet we'll use. Can someone sanity-check the YAML before I flip?

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  kv_prefetch_enabled: "true"
  kv_prefetch_window_ms: "50"
```

lia: That YAML looks good. Note: please don't increase prefetch_window >100ms during canary — OOM risk on smaller nodes.

mira: Ownership clarifying: kernel rollout = @sebastian, kv flag flip = @anika, canary ops = @lia, PR review = @ryan. Can everyone ack? Please add any concerns.

ryan: ack, I'll review ASAP and leave comments today.

sebastian: ack. I'll add a short perf test to the canary suite to monitor tail latency.

anika: ack. I'll plan the flip for Mon 08:30 UTC so infra has time to observe.

mira: Cool. Action items: 1) @ryan review PR by EOD, 2) @sebastian add perf test, 3) @anika post-config diff and flip at 08:30 Mon, 4) @lia set canary cap to 10% and schedule rollback thresholds. I'll post a short doc in #eng-runtime with the schedule. :thumbsup:

mira: Also, tagging deps: @eng-platform for rollout routing and @eng-infra for node capacity.

lia: We'll provision an extra 4 nodes Tue morning if needed.

mira: Thanks team. If no blockers, we'll proceed with the plan. Ping here if anything changes.
